name: Tool — MCP with OAuth identity passthrough
summary: MCPTool with authType='UserEntraToken' — the end user's bearer token is passed through to the MCP server.
description: An MCP tool with OAuth passthrough forwards delegated user identity to the MCP server while the Prompt Agent's orchestrator model is `{connection}/{deployment}`. This supports user-scoped tool authorization for BYOM-routed agents.
notes:
Not yet confirmed against Foundry for OAuth passthrough MCP auth. Docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/foundry/agents/how-to/mcp-authentication. See `test.py` for the `MCP_SERVER_URL_OAUTH` probe.

MCP is on the official BYOM-supported tools list, but this identity mode still needs a live OAuth-enabled server configured in the canary environment.
